note.question: How does the interplay differ between customer feedback solicitation and innovation?
note.overview: Agile product development relies on rapid iteration and customer feedback, yet firms face challenges in coordinating when to solicit feedback and when to invest in quality improvement. Although each action adds value on its own, coordinating the two introduces an additional layer of complexity. We model this problem as a semi-Markov decision process with product quality and accumulated customer feedback as state variables.
